references: Los dos mapas originales de Bitácora Amorcito, usados como referencia de estilo y paleta.

prompts.water-ripples:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art spritesheet for animated landscape details in the existing "Bitácora Amorcito" game.
The two input maps are STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets and not a layout to reproduce.
Match their crisp pixel edges, saturated blue/cyan water and white foam, warm inviting retro RPG visual language. Real transparent alpha background.
CRITICAL SHEET LAYOUT: ONE canvas, landscape 4:3, ideally EXACTLY 1448x1086 pixels. EXACTLY EIGHT equally sized frame cells arranged FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. The regular grid fills the whole canvas, zero outer margin and zero gutter; each frame cell is 362x543 pixels on the preferred canvas. Frame order: top row left to right 0,1,2,3; bottom row left to right 4,5,6,7. There are no visible grid lines, numbers, text, captions or framing. A spritesheet, NOT a collage or perspective view.
Draw the SAME isolated subject at the SAME pixel position, same bounding box, same scale and same camera in every frame cell. Leave ample transparent padding within every cell. Advance its animation by a small coherent phase in each successive frame so frames 0 through 7 form ONE SEAMLESS LOOP; 7 reconnects naturally to 0. No independent random variations or different objects. No fuzzy edges, blur, realistic rendering, black/white/color backdrop, or painted checkerboard. The artwork inside a cell must never cross its boundaries. Logical pixel blocks of about 3-4 output pixels.
Subject: a reusable small HORIZONTAL water-surface highlights overlay. Draw only several short, staggered turquoise/cyan, pale aqua and white pixel streaks, small ripples and glints; the underlying blue water will already exist in the map. Do NOT paint a solid blue water rectangle, riverbank, rocks, ground or complete river. The sparse marks occupy the central part of each frame, roughly 260 pixels wide by 100 pixels tall, centered at x=181,y=275 within each 362x543 frame; everything between highlights is transparent. The marks flow consistently to the right, break up and reform, with equal activity and brightness through the loop. Keep the same overall sparse horizontal patch footprint in all eight frames. It must overlay existing blue river without a rectangular edge.

prompts.flower-daisies:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated production PNG sprite for ambient landscape motion in "Bitácora Amorcito".
The supplied maps are STYLE AND PALETTE references only. Create a reusable asset in the same warm retro RPG pixel-art visual style, crisp deliberate pixel blocks, natural greens and creamy highlights. Real alpha transparency across the entire background. No map, ground, scene, UI, characters, signs, text, numbers, border, watermark, shadow rectangle, or checkerboard. Do not create a spritesheet or multiple versions: one single isolated object on the canvas, fully visible with clear transparent padding all around. No blur, glow, feathering, photorealism or fuzzy extraction matte.
Subject: ONE small clump of garden daisies like the reference map: three creamy white daisy heads with warm golden-yellow centers, green stems and a few oval leaves. A single connected plant, NOT scattered separate flowers, held upright with stems meeting at a common root anchor at its bottom center. The main daisy stands tallest; two smaller flowers on either side. No soil mound, pot, grass patch, roots extending sideways, floating particles or tree. Centered fully visible composition suitable for a very slight wind-sway tween around the base. Pixel-art detail similar to a 48x64 logical sprite, enlarged with crisp pixel blocks. Preferred square PNG 1024x1024.
